title: Evaluate UI Structure Audit Prompt
task: In a fictional engineering repository, for a dashboard, verify landmarks, heading order, filter grouping, result status, table semantics, empty and error states, and mobile reading order before adjusting decorative spacing.
acceptance_criteria: Annotated screenshots or runtime observations mapped to components and semantic structure.
A hierarchy and task-flow map covering landmarks, headings, groups, reading order, actions, and edge states.
Before-and-after narrow and wide evidence for every corrected structural issue.
Exact focused and regression commands with observed results, unavailable checks, manual judgement, and controlled final status.
failure_signals: Reject visual-only fixes that leave semantic hierarchy or task grouping broken.
Reject UI-structure approval based on source inspection without rendered-state evidence when a runtime is available.
